categories.main_business_segments: Highbroad Advanced Material (Hefei) Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a one-stop comprehensive solution provider for backlight display modules and key components in the semiconductor display panel industry. Its main products include backlight display modules, light guide plates, precision structural parts, and optical materials, serving applications in notebook computers, tablets, desktop displays, automotive displays, medical displays, industrial control displays, and VR devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates optical design, light guide plate design, precision mold design, overall structural design, and intelligent manufacturing. It has mastered advanced technologies such as TFT-LCD and Mini-LED backlight modules, including chip-scale packaging (POB, COB, COG), local dimming, high brightness and contrast enhancement, and anti-peep light guide plates. The firm emphasizes R&D in Mini-LED curved display technology, HUD display technology, front-light guide plate technology, reflective backlight modules, and green backlight technology, supported by automated and intelligent production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major panel manufacturers like BOE, TCL Huaxing, Innolux, and CSOT, as well as well-known consumer electronics brands such as Huawei, Lenovo, HP, Dell, Asus, and Xiaomi. Automotive manufacturers like NIO, Chery, FAW, GAC, Geely, Ford, and Aston Martin are also significant end clients. The company serves the semiconductor display industry with a focus on consumer electronics, automotive displays, medical and industrial control displays, and emerging VR/AR markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with domestic sales accounting for nearly 100% of revenue. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Hefei, Chongqing, Chuzhou, and Guangzhou. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Samoa, mainly for trade and export activities, with transactions denominated in USD and other foreign currencies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Highbroad operates mainly in the midstream of the semiconductor display supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of backlight display modules and their key components. It maintains vertical integration capabilities from optical materials processing to module assembly, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the backlight module segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in Mini-LED and Micro-LED technologies, focusing on high brightness, narrow bezel, curved and shaped displays, and automotive HUD applications. It invests in advanced optical design, large-scale transfer technologies, yield improvement, and green, sustainable materials. Digitalization and intelligent manufacturing are key strategic initiatives to enhance production efficiency and product quality. The firm also emphasizes expanding Mini-LED applications in automotive and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of backlight display modules and related components to panel manufacturers and end customers. The company uses an order-based sales model with direct sales channels, recognizing revenue upon product delivery and customer acceptance. Additional income sources include leasing, material sales, processing fees, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Highbroad is one of the larger domestic backlight display module manufacturers in China with a strong market presence and recognized brand. It competes with other major panel and module suppliers in the semiconductor display industry, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced technology, and close relationships with leading panel makers and automotive OEMs. The company holds a competitive position in Mini-LED technology and automotive display markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.35 billion, an 8.49% increase year-over-year, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 215 million, reflecting a significant profit decline due to increased costs and lower gross margins. Total assets reached RMB 5.27 billion, growing 13.08% from the previous year. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansion and increased R&D investment, though profitability is currently challenged by ramp-up costs and market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Highbroad emphasizes its one-stop comprehensive solution capability integrating optical, structural, and manufacturing expertise to deliver high-performance backlight modules. Its proprietary technologies in light guide plates, Mini-LED packaging, and automotive-grade displays provide superior brightness, contrast, and reliability. The company’s focus on intelligent manufacturing and sustainable materials enhances product quality and cost efficiency, positioning it as a preferred partner in the semiconductor display industry, especially for emerging Mini-LED and automotive display applications.
